Title: Infernal Pursuit vs Strike: Combat Ends

Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
My vampire with CEL is acting and in combat with another vampire. I
have Infernal Pursuit in hand. My vampire declares a strike; the
opposing vampire strikes: combat ends.

Is there any opportunity to play the Infernal Pursuit at CEL prior to
strike resolution? Might be helpful to dig for a Psyche!

Thanks in advance.

Jeff
